title: 2nd World Congress on Biopolymers & Bioplastics
theme: Towards Biopolymers: Catalyzing Macromolecular Innovation for a Circular World
tagline: Pioneering Sustainable Macromolecular Solutions for a Circular Future
description: The premier international assembly bringing together macromolecular chemists, bioengineers, polymer technologists, environmental scientists, and sustainable industry leaders to accelerate scalable biopolymer technologies.
detailed_about:
The 2nd World Congress on Biopolymers & Bioplastics represents the epicenter of scientific breakthrough in bio-based materials, biodegradable packaging, biomedical macromolecules, and industrial fermentation. Over two intensive days in Paris, France, leading international academicians and pioneering industry researchers will present novel synthesis pathways, enzymatic degradation mechanisms, and commercialization case studies. 

The global plastics crisis demands unprecedented scientific coordination. This congress bridges theoretical macromolecular chemistry with high-throughput industrial extrusion, bio-derived monomer catalysis, and closed-loop lifecycle governance. All accepted abstracts will be published in Scopus and Web of Science indexed proceedings, offering authors unparalleled visibility across global research institutions.

welcome_message: It is our profound honor to welcome distinguished researchers, professors, industrial pioneers, and budding scholars to the 2nd World Congress on Biopolymers & Bioplastics in Paris. Our collective mission is to decouple modern material consumption from petrochemical dependence through breakthrough green chemistry, microbial synthesis, and circular macromolecular architecture. We look forward to your impactful contributions and lively debates.

committee.name: Prof. Henriette Dubois, Ph.D.
committee.designation: Director of Macromolecular Institute & Professor of Green Chemistry
committee.biography: Prof. Dubois has spent 28 years pioneering catalytic pathways for renewable polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHAs) and bio-based nylon precursors. She has published over 210 peer-reviewed papers in Nature Materials, Macromolecules, and Green Chemistry, and holds 16 international patents in enzymatic polymer synthesis.
committee.education: Ph.D. in Polymer Chemistry, École Normale Supérieure (Paris); M.Sc. in Chemical Engineering, ParisTech
committee.experience: Former Chair of European Bioplastics Scientific Advisory Council (2018–2024); Lead Principal Investigator on EU Horizon 2020 Bio-Macromolecules Consortium.
committee.research_interests: Microbial synthesis of aliphatic polyesters, enzymatic depolymerization of polyesters, closed-loop marine biodegradable polymers.

committee.name: Dr. Kenjiro Takahashi
committee.biography: Dr. Takahashi is world-renowned for developing hyper-branched polysaccharides for biomedical drug delivery devices and heat-resistant polylactic acid (PLA) stereocomplexes for aerospace applications.
committee.education: Ph.D. in Materials Science, University of Tokyo; Postdoctoral Fellow, MIT Materials Science & Engineering.
committee.experience: Visiting Scientist at RIKEN Center for Sustainable Resource Science; recipient of the 2023 Asian Polymer Federation Excellence Award.
committee.research_interests: Polysaccharide nanocomposites, high-temperature stereocomplex PLA, bio-resorbable vascular stents.

committee.name: Prof. Elena Rostova, Ph.D.
committee.biography: Prof. Rostova specializes in life-cycle assessment (LCA), thermo-mechanical degradation kinetics, and industrial scale reactive extrusion of lignin-reinforced biocomposites.
committee.education: Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering, ETH Zurich; B.S. in Chemistry, Lomonosov Moscow State University.
committee.experience: Advises the Swiss Federal Office for the Environment on biodegradable packaging standards and microplastic remediation protocols.
committee.research_interests: Lignin valorization, biodegradable agricultural mulch films, multi-scale polymer rheology.

committee.name: Dr. Marcus Thorne
committee.designation: Chief Scientist & Senior Fellow in Biomaterials
committee.institution: Max Planck Institute for Polymer Research
committee.biography: Dr. Thorne directs fundamental studies on supramolecular assembly, bio-inspired adhesives derived from mussel foot proteins, and smart shape-memory hydrogels.
committee.education: D.Phil. in Polymer Chemistry, University of Oxford.
committee.experience: Editor-in-Chief of Advanced Sustainable Macromolecules; co-founder of two biomaterial spinouts.
committee.research_interests: Supramolecular biopolymers, mussel-inspired catechol chemistry, self-healing bio-elastomers.

committee.name: Prof. Sarah Al-Mansoor
committee.institution: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)
committee.biography: Prof. Al-Mansoor develops ultra-filtration membranes utilizing cellulose nanocrystals and functionalized chitosan for energy-efficient seawater desalination.
committee.education: Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering, Imperial College London.
committee.experience: Lead Investigator on desalination membranes; recipient of 2024 L’Oréal-UNESCO for Women in Science.
committee.research_interests: Nanocellulose separation membranes, chitosan bio-adsorbents, heavy metal remediation.

committee.name: Dr. Carlos Mendoza
committee.biography: Dr. Mendoza leads innovative agro-waste valorization projects turning agave bagasse and coffee pulp into high-purity polyhydroxybutyrate (PHB).
committee.research_interests: Solid-state fermentation, agro-waste bio-refineries, circular economy metrics.

speakers.name: Prof. Henriette Dubois, Ph.D.
speakers.biography: Leading expert in catalytic synthesis of renewable polyhydroxyalkanoates with over 25 years of experience bridging academic synthesis and pilot plant execution.
speakers.presentation_title: Next-Generation Enzymatic Synthesis of Marine-Degradable Polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHAs)
speakers.presentation_abstract: Conventional petro-chemical plastics persist in oceanic ecosystems for centuries. This keynote introduces genetically optimized Ralstonia eutropha strains that convert volatile fatty acids into high molecular weight PHAs that degrade completely in seawater within 60 days.

speakers.name: Dr. Kenjiro Takahashi
speakers.biography: Pioneer of stereocomplexed polylactic acid (sc-PLA) and biocompatible carbohydrate nanocarriers with high commercial yield.
speakers.presentation_title: Stereocomplex PLA Nanocomposites with 220°C Heat Resistance for Automotive & Aerospace
speakers.presentation_abstract: A significant bottleneck for commercial PLA has been low heat deflection temperatures. We report a novel continuous solid-state extrusion method achieving 98% stereocomplex crystallinity.

speakers.name: Prof. Elena Rostova, Ph.D.
speakers.biography: Expert on reactive extrusion, polymer rheology, and circular economy assessment models in Europe.
speakers.presentation_title: Holistic Life Cycle Assessment and Degradation Kinetics of Lignocellulosic Bioplastics
speakers.presentation_abstract: Comprehensive cradle-to-cradle LCA data demonstrating that lignin-derived aliphatic polyesters reduce cradle-to-gate carbon emissions by 68% relative to virgin polypropylene.

speakers.name: Dr. Marcus Thorne
speakers.institution: Max Planck Institute for Polymer Research
speakers.biography: Pioneered bio-inspired adhesives mimicking catechol proteins found in marine mussels for surgical wound closure.
speakers.presentation_title: Catechol-Functionalized Chitosan Hydrogels as Rapid Hemostatic Surgical Adhesives
speakers.presentation_abstract: Surgical sealants require fast adhesion in wet, dynamic physiological environments. We present dual-crosslinked catechol-chitosan networks that achieve sealing within 15 seconds.

speakers.name: Dr. Aris Thorne-Vanderbilt
speakers.biography: Leads industrial scale-up of ecovio® and certified compostable polyester blends for high-speed flexible film converting.
speakers.presentation_title: Scaling Certified Soil-Biodegradable Mulch Films to 500,000 Hectares Globally
speakers.presentation_abstract: Agricultural microplastic contamination from conventional polyethylene mulch is unsustainable. This talk discusses field trials across five climatic zones using PBAT/PLA blends.

speakers.name: Prof. Devendra Sharma
speakers.biography: Specializes in conversion of agricultural stubble (paddy straw) into bio-cellulose and packaging foams via green deep eutectic solvents.
speakers.presentation_title: Deep Eutectic Solvent Delignification of Agricultural Stubble for Thermally Insulating Bio-Foams
speakers.presentation_abstract: Direct conversion of rice straw into biodegradable expanded packaging foams replacing expanded polystyrene (EPS) with zero toxic effluent.

sessions.title: Biopolymers & Bioplastics: Fundamental Synthesis & Polymer Chemistry
sessions.description: Exploration of organocatalytic, metal-free, and bio-derived ring-opening polymerization of lactides, lactones, and novel bio-monomers.

sessions.title: Microbial Synthesis & Fermentation of Polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHAs & PHBs)
sessions.description: High-cell-density fermentation strategies, genetically engineered methanotrophic bacteria, and volatile fatty acid feedstock utilization.

sessions.title: Polylactic Acid (PLA): Stereocomplexes, Blends & High-Temperature Processing
sessions.description: Engineering thermal stability, barrier performance, nucleating agents, and continuous reactive extrusion for automotive parts.

sessions.title: Marine Biodegradation & Oceanic Microplastic Mitigation
sessions.description: Mechanistic pathways of enzymatic disintegration in benthic and pelagic marine environments; standardized OECD 306 degradation assays.

sessions.title: Cellulose Nanocrystals (CNC) & Nanofibrillated Cellulose in Composites
sessions.description: Isolation techniques, mechanical reinforcement thresholds, transparent conductive nanocellulose films, and green aero-gels.

sessions.title: Bio-Based Polymers in Medical Devices, Tissue Engineering & Drug Delivery
sessions.description: Bio-resorbable vascular scaffolds, 3D bio-printable hydrogels, electrospun nanofiber wound dressings, and targeted drug release matrices.

sessions.title: Lignin Valorization & Lignocellulosic Biorefineries
sessions.description: Fractionation of industrial kraft lignin, catalytic hydrogenolysis to aromatic monomers, and high-performance carbon fibers.

sessions.title: Advanced Sustainable Food Packaging & High-Barrier Biopolymer Films
sessions.description: Oxygen and water vapor transmission rate (WVTR) optimization, active anti-microbial coatings with essential oils, and smart freshness sensors.

sessions.title: Enzymatic Recycling & Bio-Catalytic Upcycling of Post-Consumer Plastics
sessions.description: Engineered PETase and MHETase enzyme cascades, continuous depolymerization reactors, and monomer-grade recycling loops.

sessions.title: Chitosan, Alginate & Marine Macromolecules
sessions.description: Extraction from crustacean and brown macro-algal biomass, chemical derivatization, water treatment flocculants, and edible coatings.

sessions.title: Agricultural Mulch Films: Soil Degradability, Standards & Ecotoxicity
sessions.description: ISO 17556 soil biodegradability validation, terrestrial ecotoxicity assays, crop yield comparisons, and PBAT/starch co-extrusions.

sessions.title: Bio-Polyurethanes & Bio-Polyamides from Non-Food Vegetable Oils
sessions.description: Castor oil, soybean, and tall oil-derived polyols; isocyanate-free non-isocyanate polyurethanes (NIPU) synthesis for coatings and foams.

sessions.title: Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), Carbon Accounting & Circularity Metrics
sessions.description: Harmonized European and global LCA methodologies, indirect land use change (ILUC) modeling, carbon sequestration tracking, and ESG criteria.

sessions.title: 3D & 4D Additive Manufacturing with Bio-Based Filaments and Resins
sessions.description: Fused filament fabrication (FFF) with wood-flour biocomposites, photopolymerizable plant-oil resins, and shape-memory biopolymers.

sessions.title: Smart, Responsive & Self-Healing Biopolymer Networks
sessions.description: Dynamic covalent disulfide and boronate ester bonds, thermo-responsive and pH-responsive supramolecular gels for electronic skins.

sessions.title: Starch-Based Polymers & Thermoplastic Starch (TPS) Formulations
sessions.description: Plasticizer migration kinetics, retrogradation suppression, multi-layer co-extrusion with PBAT, and water-soluble packaging applications.

sessions.title: Global Regulatory Frameworks, Bioplastics Certification & Standards
sessions.description: EN 13432 industrial composting standards, TÜV Austria OK Compost HOME certifications, ASTM D6400, and green claims verification laws.

sessions.title: Industrial Scale-Up, High-Throughput Extrusion & Rheology
sessions.description: Twin-screw extrusion dynamics, melt strength enhancement with chain extenders, blow molding stabilization, and pelletizing economics.

sessions.title: Young Scientist & Emerging Scholar Flash Oral Session
sessions.description: Competitive 5-minute flash presentations by doctoral candidates and postdoctoral fellows showcasing rapid innovations.

sessions.title: Commercialization, Venture Capital & Academic Spin-Out Showcase
sessions.description: Leading venture capital investors, tech transfer executives, and startup founders presenting scale-up investments and partnership models.

committee.name: Prof. Henriette Dubois, Ph.D.
committee.designation: Director of Macromolecular Institute & Professor of Green Chemistry
committee.biography: Prof. Dubois has spent 28 years pioneering catalytic pathways for renewable polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHAs) and bio-based nylon precursors. She has published over 210 peer-reviewed papers in Nature Materials, Macromolecules, and Green Chemistry, and holds 16 international patents in enzymatic polymer synthesis.
committee.education: Ph.D. in Polymer Chemistry, École Normale Supérieure (Paris); M.Sc. in Chemical Engineering, ParisTech
committee.experience: Former Chair of European Bioplastics Scientific Advisory Council (2018–2024); Lead Principal Investigator on EU Horizon 2020 Bio-Macromolecules Consortium.
committee.research_interests: Microbial synthesis of aliphatic polyesters, enzymatic depolymerization of polyesters, closed-loop marine biodegradable polymers.

committee.name: Dr. Kenjiro Takahashi
committee.biography: Dr. Takahashi is world-renowned for developing hyper-branched polysaccharides for biomedical drug delivery devices and heat-resistant polylactic acid (PLA) stereocomplexes for aerospace applications.
committee.education: Ph.D. in Materials Science, University of Tokyo; Postdoctoral Fellow, MIT Materials Science & Engineering.
committee.experience: Visiting Scientist at RIKEN Center for Sustainable Resource Science; recipient of the 2023 Asian Polymer Federation Excellence Award.
committee.research_interests: Polysaccharide nanocomposites, high-temperature stereocomplex PLA, bio-resorbable vascular stents.

committee.name: Prof. Elena Rostova, Ph.D.
committee.biography: Prof. Rostova specializes in life-cycle assessment (LCA), thermo-mechanical degradation kinetics, and industrial scale reactive extrusion of lignin-reinforced biocomposites.
committee.education: Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering, ETH Zurich; B.S. in Chemistry, Lomonosov Moscow State University.
committee.experience: Advises the Swiss Federal Office for the Environment on biodegradable packaging standards and microplastic remediation protocols.
committee.research_interests: Lignin valorization, biodegradable agricultural mulch films, multi-scale polymer rheology.

committee.name: Dr. Marcus Thorne
committee.designation: Chief Scientist & Senior Fellow in Biomaterials
committee.institution: Max Planck Institute for Polymer Research
committee.biography: Dr. Thorne directs fundamental studies on supramolecular assembly, bio-inspired adhesives derived from mussel foot proteins, and smart shape-memory hydrogels.
committee.education: D.Phil. in Polymer Chemistry, University of Oxford.
committee.experience: Editor-in-Chief of Advanced Sustainable Macromolecules; co-founder of two biomaterial spinouts.
committee.research_interests: Supramolecular biopolymers, mussel-inspired catechol chemistry, self-healing bio-elastomers.

committee.name: Prof. Sarah Al-Mansoor
committee.institution: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)
committee.biography: Prof. Al-Mansoor develops ultra-filtration membranes utilizing cellulose nanocrystals and functionalized chitosan for energy-efficient seawater desalination.
committee.education: Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering, Imperial College London.
committee.experience: Lead Investigator on desalination membranes; recipient of 2024 L’Oréal-UNESCO for Women in Science.
committee.research_interests: Nanocellulose separation membranes, chitosan bio-adsorbents, heavy metal remediation.

committee.name: Dr. Carlos Mendoza
committee.biography: Dr. Mendoza leads innovative agro-waste valorization projects turning agave bagasse and coffee pulp into high-purity polyhydroxybutyrate (PHB).
committee.research_interests: Solid-state fermentation, agro-waste bio-refineries, circular economy metrics.

title: 8th International Congress on Quantum Computing & Advanced Materials
theme: Engineering Next-Generation Quantum Coherence and Topological Nanostructures
tagline: Pioneering Scalable Quantum Architectures and Superconducting Materials
description: The world premier gathering of quantum physicists, topological material scientists, cryogenics engineers, and algorithm architects convening to accelerate scalable quantum coherent systems.
detailed_about:
QuantumMat 2026 represents the pinnacle of global scientific collaboration in quantum information systems and superconducting topological matters. Over three intensive days in Boston, world-renowned academicians, Nobel laureates, and industry leaders will present groundbreaking breakthroughs in trapped-ion qubits, fault-tolerant error correction, cryogenic CMOS interfacing, and 2D materials.

All accepted and peer-reviewed abstracts will be published in Scopus and Web of Science indexed international proceedings, granting authors immediate global scientific recognition and citations across premier databases.
